senses.gloss: m. (נְחַת) one going or coming down, esp. one coming from Palestine to Babylonia.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 8:1:3">Y. Shek. VIII, 51ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>אבדומא נ׳</he> (not <cite ref="A00062"><he>אבודמא</he></cite>) A. who had been in Babylonia.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 9:3:15">Y. Kil. IX, 32ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>עולא נ׳ הוה</he> Ulla had gone to Babylonia; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 12:3:15">Y. Keth. XII, 35ᵇ</cite> bot. (not <cite ref="P00817"><he>עללא</he></cite>).—Pl. constr. <he>נָחוֹתֵי</he>.
Targ. Ps. CXV, 17 ed. Lag. (ed. נָחֲתֵי); a. fr.—נ׳ ימא sea-farers.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 42:10">Targ. Is. XLII, 10</cite> <he>נַחֲתֵי</he>.—
<cite ref="Shabbat 20b:8">Sabb. 20ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Shabbat 90a:5">90ᵃ</cite> <he>שאילתינהו לכל נ׳ י׳</he>, I inquired of all sea-farers.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 85a:4">B. Mets. 85ᵃ</cite> (not <cite ref="N00496"><he>נחיתי</he></cite>); a. fr.
